title: Auth header injection repeated 5x: extract to inject_auth helper
description: The pattern 'if let Some((name, value)) = self.auth.auth_header() { req = req.header(name, value); }' appears identically in fetch_session, call, subscribe_events, upload_blob, and download_blob. A contributor adding a new method will copy-paste this pattern. Fix: add private fn inject_auth(&self, builder: reqwest::RequestBuilder) -> reqwest::RequestBuilder that applies auth and returns the builder.
